_about: Targets for the nocturne 'hyper-real ethereal night' look, DERIVED FROM THE USER'S CONCEPT ART (assets/concept-art/nocturne-reservoir + nocturne-world-v1, 4 images, measured with tools/colour/metrics.py; reference values in docs/screenshots/references/metrics.json). Ranges = reference min/max widened ~15%. Checked by metrics.py report --targets. Framing-independent band metrics (top/bottom quarter) are used instead of ROIs.

luma_p1.basis: ref 0.030-0.055: blacks are lifted, never crushed

top_luma.basis: ref 0.12-0.17: sky is mid-dark, not black

bottom_chroma.basis: ref 0.017-0.021: ground is neutral stone; ours 0.055 periwinkle

warm_pct_hue30_110.basis: ref 2.8-23% of coloured pixels are warm amber (lit lamps, strips); ours <1% except overview

split_tone_hue_gap_deg.basis: ref 107-172: cool blue shadows (hue ~255) vs amber highlights (hue ~65-95)
